info.title: Sanskrit Dictionary API
info.description: Read-only dictionary API: lexicons, thesauri, dhatu works, sutra commentaries, paradigms.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Root, upadesha, artha or number filter

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Jump to headword instead of seq

get.summary:
Paradigms whose stem is the query, plus — when the query is a root — its
conjugation and all kṛdanta stems derived from it.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Stem or root in any script

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Query in Devanagari, IAST, Harvard-Kyoto, ITRANS, SLP1 or lipilekhika Normal

parameters.name: forms
parameters.description: Inflected-form analysis: 1 (default) or 0 to skip it

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: 1 returns every sūtra (q ignored, no limit)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Root in Devanagari (भू, एधँ), a meaning word, or a code (1.1, 01.0001)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Root id of the site's Dhātupāṭha (`/dhatu/{id}`)

200.description: The same root in vidyut's Dhātupāṭha

404.description: No such root, or vidyut has no matching root

200.description: Kṛdanta stems of the root, grouped
The joined phrase (variants when sandhi is optional)

400.description: Fewer than two words / not Devanagari

200.description: Every lakāra of the root in this prayoga, per pada

400.description: Bad root / upasarga, or no forms

center.description: The seq the window is centered on (the jump target when `q` was given)

splits.description: Both parts known first, then one part known, then the rest (each in split order).

stems.description: The root after sanādi / upasarga (e.g. भावि for भू + णिच्).

tables.description: One set of tables per pada the root takes in this prayoga (ubhayapadī roots get both).

stems.description: The stem the table is built on (derived stems spelled out).

optional_rules.description: The optional rules this result depends on (why a cell has several forms).

DhatuArgs.description:
A root from the Dhātupāṭha, optionally with sanādi suffixes (in order: `[nic, san]` is the
desiderative of the causative) and upasargas (Devanagari: `प्र`, `सम्`, `आ`).

ErrorBody.description: JSON error body (`{ "error": string }`) — also the OpenAPI error schema.

analysis.description: e.g. `पुमान् · तृतीया · एकः; नपुंसकम् · तृतीया · एकः`

cells.description: Cell numbers of the form in each paradigm (parallel to `paradigm_ids`)

paradigm_ids.description: Paradigms containing the form (first is the primary one)

krt.description: vidyut kṛt label (SLP1) — pass back as `krt` in [`StemArgs::Krdanta`].

lingas.description: Genders the stem is declined in (empty for indeclinables).

LakaraId.description: Lakāra (tense / mood). The Vedic leṭ is left out.

LakaraTable.description:
`forms[purusha][vacana]` = the variants for that cell (puruṣa: prathama, madhyama, uttama;
vacana: eka, dvi, bahu).

padas.description: Vṛtta: one entry per distinct pāda (samavṛttas have one).

note.description: e.g. "vipulā" for a śloka whose odd pāda leaves the common (pathyā) pattern.

applied.description: Whether this derivation applied the optional rule.

dhatu_id.description: This root's page on the site (`/dhatu/{id}`), when the site's Dhātupāṭha has it.

aupadeshika.description: Aupadeśika form with it-markers and accents (e.g. `एधँ॒`).

roots.description: The root after it-lopa (e.g. `एध्`); several when it-lopa allows options.

sutra_id.description:
This site's sūtra id (`3.2.123` → `3.2.123`, `1.1.1` → `1.1.001`) for Aṣṭādhyāyī rules and
for vārttikas / Kāśikā notes on one.

url.description: Link for references outside the shipped texts.

stem.description: Devanagari stem (`राजन्`), or an indeclinable for the first member of an avyayībhāva.

words.description:
Nominative in each gender the compound takes (dual for itaretara-dvandva; the indeclinable
for avyayībhāva).

SanadiId.description: Sanādi pratyayas that make a new root from a root (the nāmadhātu ones are not exposed).

ganas.description: The pattern in gaṇas (य म त र ज भ न स, then ल / ग for the rest).

others.description: Other vṛttas the text is compatible with.

left_known.description: The part is a headword or a known inflected form in the dictionaries.

oneOf.description: Only for śatṛ / śānac (laṭ or lṛṭ).
Only for śatṛ / śānac (karmaṇi śānac = present passive participle).

StemArgs.description: A nominal stem (prātipadika): typed as is, or derived (kṛdanta, taddhitānta, samāsa).

linga.description: The gender to decline it in first (तल् → strī, त्व / ष्यञ् → napuṃsaka).

taddhita.description: vidyut taddhita label (SLP1) — pass back as `taddhita` in [`StemArgs::Taddhitanta`].

oneOf.description: The root with its sanādi / upasargas.

WordSpec.description: A word (or stem / root / phrase) to derive step by step.

tags.name: vidyut
tags.description: Grammar tools on Ambuda's vidyut: word generation, meter, sandhi
